lead.bone: thin irregular human-written Chinese, narrow-to-moderate proportions

core.bone: oversized uneven hand-lettered Latin or short Chinese with irregular edge, lively stems and descender

promise.bone: large hand-drawn Chinese with open counters, small stroke-width variation, human alignment

surface: opaque high-value warm-white fill, sparse local rubbed edge, short soft shadow added during composition
forbidden: regular computer font with uniform noise
identical tilt and stroke on every character
closed or malformed Chinese character structure
background or phone baked into text layer
